name: Shanti Spintex Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Shanti Spintex Ltd 
is in the business of manufacturing & trading of denim textile products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SSL manufactures denim fabrics, offering 6 types in 6 shades, sold to manufacturers, wholesalers, and traders across Gujarat. The company also operates a wind farm and a rooftop solar plant.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.04 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 55.5 to 35.3 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
